_readme: Operator public keys for Web Bot Auth verification (Ed25519, RFC 9421). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Add entries as { "<operator>": { "keyid": "<id>", "publicKey": "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----...", "domain": "<operator domain>" } }. The demo keypair for the simulator is registered in-memory by the server at boot (operator "demo-agent"); it is NOT stored here. VERIGUS_OPERATOR_KEYS env (same JSON shape) merges over this file.
